summary: Never exited: the leg was a persistent, saw-toothed favorable move that kept making higher highs (peaked near +175) despite repeated 30-80% intra-leg givebacks and short bursts where both HA and PROPP fired against the position. Each pullback that looked like a reversal (low ER10, negative lambda across TFs, giveback>50%) resolved back to new highs within 1-3 frames, so I treated recurring giveback as noise rather than signal. Next time I'd watch for a giveback that fails to make a new high within ~3 frames combined with sustained (not single-bar) against-fires across HA+PROPP+lambda as the actual exit trigger, since here that combination never lasted long enough to justify cutting.
